newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against dollar to 6.7520 /dlr.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against dollar to 6.7520 /dlr.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr weakened further against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.7520 against the dollar compared to 6.7020 last Friday.
The bank, at the weekly currency auction on June 7, set the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the June 9 to 15 period at 6.7520 birr to the dollar.
The bank also posted the birr at a mean rate of 10.9774 against the pound from 10.9443 last Friday, while against the yen the birr traded at 0.058292 from 0.057965 last Friday.
